posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
jmrburgard:

*Yes, I am totally aware it is not really a dinosaur.

Whenever I want to refer to dinosaurs in a fantasy context, where I don't want to use clinical-sounding scientific terms, I call them "saurians".  Since this is a completely made-up term, it's free to include anything that seems to fit ("Salmon is totally a red meat!"), while excluding anything that doesn't ("Tomatoes are a fruit? Get real!").  Thusly, while a pterodactyl (or a plesiosaur) may not be a dinosaur, it is totally a saurian.
